subject: Procurement intake: PR setup & supplier onboarding for BrightByte POC

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>

Cc:

Subject: Procurement intake: PR setup & supplier onboarding for BrightByte POC

Hi Sarah —

Great to meet today. Quick recap and a suggested path to get the POC transacting:

1) Commercial path check: you mentioned procurement prefers a PO process for vendors. Can you confirm whether Payments will be via PO (net-30) or Procurement Card (PCard)? That determines the PR path.

2) Supplier onboarding: you said BrightByte is active in Coupa. Please confirm the supplier ID (or send the vendor form) so we can link it to our PR. If you don’t have a supplier ID we’ll kick off vendor setup with finance.

3) Marketplace option: we can also ship via AWS Marketplace listing (faster for procurement in some orgs). Is marketplace acceptance something you want us to prioritize?

4) Internal items I need from you: a) procurement contact (name + email), b) preferred payment method (PO vs PCard), c) estimated initial spend or ARR band for contract routing.

Attached: PR_Template_Workday.xlsx (fill cost center & item lines).

Next steps I propose: you reply with the supplier info and preferred payment path; I’ll loop in Karh and Marissa for PR creation and vendor linkage and open the internal ticket. If BrightByte prefers the marketplace route we’ll pause vendor setup and share the marketplace order link instead.

Thanks —
Logan Wright
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
log an.wright@redwood.com | (415) 555-0132
Redwood Inference

Hi Logan —

Thanks for the summary and the template. A few notes from our side:

- Procurement preference: PO (net-30) — we do not use PCard for new vendor engagements over $5k.
- Supplier platform: we use Coupa. Our procurement team provided a supplier ID when we onboarded last year; I'll confirm the exact ID but Emily (cc'd) manages vendor workstreams.
- Marketplace: not a priority for this POC — we need an executed SOW + PO.
- Initial spend estimate: $18k-$25k for the first quarter.

Attached: BrightByte_SupplierForm.pdf (filled). Emily, can you share the supplier ID and preferred remittance details?

Quick internal checklist (to follow for any PR intake):

- If supplier missing -> open VendorSetup (SUP-3456) and include supplier form + W9.
- Create PR in Workday using PR_Template_Workday.xlsx (line items, qty, unit price, cost_center).
- Attach SOW/DocuSign link and route for approval (Legal + Sales Ops).
- Confirm PO number, return to customer with PO PDF.

Related ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SUP-3456
DocuSign (SOW) will be shared by EOD after countersign.
